newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Time says revises Sapura acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Time says revises Sapura acquisition.

text.p: Time Engineering Bhd said its proposed acquisition of a 75 percent stake in payphone operator Uniphone Sdn Bhd has been approved by the Securities Commission, but the purchase price was revised to 470 million ringgit from 450 million.
The telecommunications and engineering firm said in a statement the purchase would be paid by an issue of 94.95 million new Time shares at 4.95 ringgit per share.
Due to the revision, the proposed 20 million ringgit compensation to Sapura Holdings Sdn Bhd, the seller of the stake, would not be paid, it said.
Time's proposal to buy a 75 percent stake in cellular phone company Sapura Digital Sdn Bhd, also from Sapura Holdings, for 750 million ringgit was earlier approved by the Securities Commission.
